# Vej

> Vej is a 2B text model you run yourself that returns native probabilities over developer-supplied outcomes. It provides native distributions without text generation, JSON parsing, or answer-token scoring. Apache-2.0 code and adaptations, research alpha, text only.

Last updated: 2026-10-10.

Contact: [hello@itsvej.com](mailto:hello@itsvej.com). Access to the checkpoint is by request.

## Key Facts
- Three primitives: Choice (pick among named options), Noul (assess statement truth as true/false), Score (rate rubric levels with expectation computed in caller code).
- Architecture: Frozen BF16 Qwen3.5-2B text backbone, rank-16 alpha-32 LoRA adapters, and a trained FP32 scalar decision head (~16.82M trainable parameters).
- Checkpoint: Full native state dict of ~3.6 GiB. Runs on a single 16 GB GPU or CPU fallback. Repeated state encoding. An experimental private vLLM classification export exists; numerical and contract parity gates have not passed. Use the native loader for supported inference.
- Test performance: 76.60% exact accuracy overall across 14,286 frozen test decisions (Choice 89.22%, Noul 91.71%, Score 51.62%).
- Hosted Jev comparison: Hosted Jev 1.13 scored 71.76% overall on the same test rows with documented rounding adjustment. Jev returned 99.31% strict format validity. This is not a claim of general superiority.
- Availability: Checkpoint is hosted privately on Hugging Face (Kennes/vej-qwen-2b-alpha2) for authorised account members. Core development repository is private.
- Licensing: Vej code and model adaptations are Apache-2.0. Qwen base model and original datasets retain their respective terms.

- Interfaces: `vej predict` CLI; `vej serve --backend local` with `/v1/predict`, `/v1/systemone` for the TypeSafe Python SDK, and the Cloudflare Clef Workers AI route. All require private checkpoint access. Serving, SDK adapters, export and the context override require current private Vej source; the release source archive predates them.
- Context: 2,048 tokens per rendered candidate by default; native Qwen accepts `--max-length 49152`. Long-context quality is not validated.
- Vision: Text decisions; an untrained vision input path also exists. No vision decision quality has been measured.
- Research: Noul improvement work paused on 2026-10-09 without promoting a new model; alpha2 and its published evaluation are unchanged.

## Changes since September
- 2026-10-10 site update: documents local HTTP, Jev/Clef SDK compatibility, the experimental private `Kennes/vej-qwen-2b-alpha2-vllm` export, and the context override.
- 2026-10-09 research pause: no new checkpoint promoted.
- 2026-10-08 accepted design: EU-hosted API in development; content retention wording is a design goal.

## Aggregate Evidence Files
- [evaluation.json](https://itsvej.com/evidence/evaluation.json): Full metrics, slice breakdowns, and reliability bins across all 14,286 test decisions.
- [jev-comparison.json](https://itsvej.com/evidence/jev-comparison.json): Same-test aggregate comparison between Vej alpha2 and hosted Jev 1.13, including strict and adjusted metrics.
- [tool-evaluation.json](https://itsvej.com/evidence/tool-evaluation.json): Diagnostic results on workflow actions and tool call readiness.
- [descriptive-controls.json](https://itsvej.com/evidence/descriptive-controls.json): Post-hoc majority and descriptive baseline controls.
- [DATA_SOURCES.md](https://itsvej.com/evidence/DATA_SOURCES.md): Publisher sources, split allocations, and original licence notices.
- [DATASET_CARD.md](https://itsvej.com/evidence/DATASET_CARD.md): Dataset composition, selection rules, and filtering criteria.

## Operational Boundaries (Not Claimed)
- Not production-ready: Research alpha with limited tool diagnostic reliability (30/48 harder cases passed) and weak Score accuracy (51.62%).
- No calibrated risk: Descriptive probabilities are not guarantees of correctness or authorisation to execute tools.
- No speed claim: Inference uses repeated state encoding; AMD development measurements exist; no production latency, capacity or speed advantage is claimed.
- Hosted option: An EU SaaS API is in development for realtime, Jev/Clef wire formats and customer-storage batch. It is designed so that request content is not stored on our side; that is a design goal until launch checks pass.
